_comment: V3: Error memory system for MixCoach JUCE/C++ project. No V2 legacy references. Patterns matched by error_code + pattern text.

patterns.cause: Missing implementation for declared function or method
patterns.fix_strategy: Check that the .cpp file exists and is included in CMakeLists.txt. Verify function signature matches declaration exactly (const-ness, reference vs pointer, default params).

common_cases: Missing JUCE module registration in CMakeLists.txt (juce_audio_processors, juce_dsp, etc.)
Virtual method without implementation in derived class
Static member missing definition in .cpp file
Missing template specialization definition
Missing inline function body in header

patterns.cause: Static data member or function referenced but not defined
patterns.fix_strategy: Ensure static members have definitions in the corresponding .cpp file. Check for dllimport/dllexport mismatches.

common_cases: JUCE_*_EXPORT macro mismatch between Debug/Release configs
Static const member defined in header but not in cpp

patterns.cause: Type mismatch in function call
patterns.fix_strategy: Check parameter types: const correctness, reference vs value, JUCE String vs const char*, std::string vs juce::String
patterns.last_fix_description: Added .toRawUTF8() for juce::String to const char* conversion

common_cases: juce::String passed where const char* expected (use .toRawUTF8())
Missing const& in callback signature
int vs size_t conversion in FFT/block operations
float vs double in DSP calculations

patterns.cause: Missing #include or typo in symbol name
patterns.fix_strategy: Add the required #include. Check namespace (juce:: prefix, std:: prefix). Verify symbol spelling.

common_cases: Missing #include <juce_dsp/juce_dsp.h> for FFT operations
Missing #include "../audio/AudioAnalyzer.h" for getMasterAnalysis()
Missing #include "SharedData.h" for getTrackAudioResult()
Missing #include <atomic> for std::atomic

patterns.cause: Function not declared or included
patterns.fix_strategy: Add forward declaration or #include. Check namespace qualification.

common_cases: AudioAnalysis::measureRMS() called without #include "AudioAnalysis.h"
std::vector used without #include <vector>
Missing JUCE namespace (juce:: prefix)

patterns.cause: Incomplete type (forward declared but not fully defined)
patterns.fix_strategy: Move #include from .cpp to .h, or add forward declaration. The type needs to be fully defined where used.
patterns.last_fix_description: Moved SharedData.h include to header file

common_cases: Using AudioAnalysis members after only forward declaration
Including SharedData.h after only forward declaring SharedData

patterns.cause: Class has unimplemented pure virtual methods
patterns.fix_strategy: Implement all pure virtual methods from base class. Check JUCE AudioProcessor::getBusesLayout() and similar.

common_cases: Missing AudioProcessor::getName() override
Missing AudioProcessor::acceptsMidi() / producesMidi() overrides
Missing getTailLengthSeconds() override
Missing AudioProcessorEditor::resized() or paint() override
Missing isBusesLayoutSupported() override

patterns.pattern: attempting to reference a deleted function
patterns.cause: Trying to copy a non-copyable object (unique_ptr, atomic, mutex, etc.)
patterns.fix_strategy: Use std::move(), pass by reference, or store as pointer/shared_ptr.
patterns.last_fix_description: Fixed unique_ptr copy in class with JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE

common_cases: std::atomic<float> in a struct that gets copied
juce::AudioBuffer copied instead of passed by reference
std::unique_ptr in a class with JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE

patterns.cause: Mixing Debug and Release compiled objects
patterns.fix_strategy: Clean rebuild. Ensure all .obj files are from same build configuration. Run cmake --build Builds --clean-first --config Release

common_cases: MixCoach_SharedCode.lib built as Debug but linked into Release VST3
Partial rebuild after switching configs
CMake cache outdated after config switch

patterns.cause: Compile-time assertion failed
patterns.fix_strategy: Read the assertion message. Common causes: invalid template parameter, alignment requirement not met, JUCE version incompatibility.

common_cases: JUCE version requirements for specific dsp::FFT parameters
Buffer size alignment requirements
Template parameter constraints

patterns.cause: Required JUCE module not included in CMakeLists.txt
patterns.fix_strategy: Add JUCE_MODULE_NAME to JUCE modules list in CMakeLists.txt. Common: juce_dsp, juce_audio_utils, juce_graphics.

common_cases: juce_dsp needed for FFT, IIR, etc.
juce_audio_utils needed for AudioFormatManager
juce_gui_extra needed for WebBrowser or advanced controls
juce_audio_plugin_client needed for VST3/AAX targets

patterns.cause: Pipe operator (| tail, | Tee-Object) swallows the exit code of the preceding command. cmake --build fails but tail/Tee-Object returns 0.
patterns.fix_strategy: Always capture $LASTEXITCODE or $? BEFORE any pipe operation. In PowerShell: `$result = cmd 2>&1; $exit = $LASTEXITCODE; $result | Tee-Object log`. In bash: use PIPESTATUS or set -o pipefail.
patterns.last_fix_description: Fixed build.ps1 to capture $LASTEXITCODE before Tee-Object pipe

common_cases: build.ps1 line 87: $buildResult = cmake ... | Tee-Object → $LASTEXITCODE es 0 siempre
cmake --build ... | tail -10 → exit code 0 aunque cmake falle
Cualquier pipe en PowerShell o bash que oculte el error real

patterns.pattern: function does not accept N arguments / unresolved external
patterns.cause: Declaration in .h file has different number/types of parameters than definition in .cpp file. Not caught until linking.
patterns.fix_strategy: Compare .h declaration with .cpp definition. Check: param count, const qualifiers, reference vs value, default params. Use code-searcher to find all call sites. ALWAYS update the .h declaration when changing a function's signature in .cpp.
patterns.last_fix_description: Added missing 'float peakHold' parameter to drawVUMeter() declaration in header

common_cases: Header has 2 float params but cpp has 3
Header uses const& but cpp uses value (or vice versa)
Default params in header but not in definition
Adding a new parameter to a UI drawing function in .cpp but forgetting the .h
Changing parameter types (float to double, value to const&) in one file but not the other
project_specific.prevention: After changing any function signature, do: code-searcher with function name in *.h files to verify declaration matches definition

patterns.cause: A .cpp/.h file is used in the code (via #include or class usage) but not listed in CMakeLists.txt target_sources(). The linker finds the declarations but no implementations.
patterns.fix_strategy: Add the missing .h and .cpp files to CMakeLists.txt under the appropriate target_sources(). Check: every #include in the code has a corresponding source entry in CMakeLists.txt.
patterns.last_fix_description: Added CrestPanel.h/.cpp to MixCoach target_sources in CMakeLists.txt

common_cases: New UI component added to project but not registered in CMakeLists.txt
Refactored class into separate files but old file list not updated
Split header into .h/.cpp but only .h added to CMakeLists.txt

patterns.cause: CMake configuration failure
patterns.fix_strategy: Check CMakeLists.txt for syntax errors. Verify JUCE path. Run `cmake -B Builds -S .` to regenerate.
patterns.last_fix_description: Fixed JUCE_ROOT path after project directory move

common_cases: JUCE_ROOT path incorrect after moving project
Missing JuceHeader.h or JUCE/modules directory
Incompatible CMake version

patterns.cause: Post-build or custom command failed
patterns.fix_strategy: Check the custom command in .vcxproj or CMakeLists.txt. Common: deployment script, resource compilation.
patterns.last_fix_description: Fixed DeployVST3.ps1 path in post-build step

common_cases: DeployVST3.ps1 deployment script failed — check paths/permissions
Resource compilation (.rc) file missing
Post-build copy command failed

patterns.cause: Internal MSBuild crash (transient)
patterns.fix_strategy: Rerun the build. If persistent, clean build. Use --clean-first flag.
patterns.last_fix_description: Clean build resolved the transient crash

common_cases: Transient crash in CL.exe — retry with cmake --build Builds --config Release
Transient linker crash — retry with larger virtual memory
Use --clean-first for persistent failures

patterns.cause: Audio processing produces NaN or denormal values
patterns.fix_strategy: Add denormal protection (JUCE::FloatVectorOperations::disableDenormals). Check division by zero, log(0), sqrt(negative). Add tinit=1 or _MM_SET_FLUSH_ZERO_MODE(_MM_FLUSH_ZERO_ON).
patterns.last_fix_description: Added safe_sqrt() wrapper and denormal protection in AudioAnalysis.cpp

common_cases: RMS calculation: sum of squares could overflow
FFT processing with silent input -> division by zero in normalization
Phase calculation: atan2(0,0) -> NaN
Peak detection: sample values beyond expected range

patterns.cause: Cannot open or create shared memory mapping
patterns.fix_strategy: Check slot index uniqueness. Verify no leftover mappings from crashes. Map name must be unique per project. Use Local\MixCoachSharedMemV2 format.
patterns.last_fix_description: Fixed map name collision between VST3 instances

common_cases: SlotRegistry::registerSlot returns -1 when all slots are full
SharedMemoryManager::initialize fails on second plugin instance
FL Studio scanning causes slot collisions during plugin scan
Plugin instance count exceeds kSharedMaxSlots (128)

patterns.cause: Heavy processing on UI/message thread
patterns.fix_strategy: Move heavy computation to background thread (std::thread). Use juce::Timer for lightweight periodic updates only. Audio thread must never wait for UI thread.
patterns.last_fix_description: Moved analyzer data processing to background thread

common_cases: AudioAnalyzer::flushBuffer() called on message thread (heavy FFT)
Too many repaints per frame causing 100%% CPU
Background worker blocking on SharedData lock

fix_history.fix: Added safe_sqrt() wrapper in AudioAnalysis.h for denormal protection
Clean rebuild with --clean-first flag resolved iterator debug level mismatch

auto_learned_patterns.cause: Elliptical vs circular coordinate math: Y coordinates computed for a circle but the arc is an ellipse (vertical radius = half of horizontal). Common mistake: forgetting the elliptical ratio when computing points on an elliptical arc.
auto_learned_patterns.fix_strategy: Identify the arc's bounding ellipse: (cx, cy) center, (radius, halfR) radii. For any point at angle a: x = cx + cos(a)*radius, y = cy + sin(a)*halfR. NEVER use the same scaling for X and Y. The vertical radius is always halfR = radius * 0.5f.
auto_learned_patterns.last_fix_description: Fixed needle trajectory from circular to elliptical path using halfR/radius scaling factor

common_cases: Drawing tick marks on VU meter arc: Y = cy + sin(a)*halfR - halfR (erroneous -halfR offset)
Needle/cursor following the arc: Needle tip used circular path (radius for both X and Y) but arc is elliptical (radius for X, halfR for Y)
Pivot/center point wrong: Using (cx, cy - halfR) instead of (cx, cy) as the ellipse center

fix_guide.formula:
x = cx + cos(angle) * radius
y = cy + sin(angle) * halfR
common_mistakes: y = cy + sin(a) * radius (ignores ellipse vertical compression)
y = cy + sin(a) * halfR - halfR (extra offset moves everything)
pivot = (cx, cy - halfR) instead of (cx, cy)

auto_learned_patterns.pattern: needle out of scale|indicator out of bounds|marker beyond range
auto_learned_patterns.cause: The indicator (needle, marker) uses a different angular range than the scale marks. Common: needle sweeps the full arc (270°) but scale marks only cover a portion (198°). At mid-values, the needle points far beyond the last scale mark.
auto_learned_patterns.fix_strategy: Verify that the needle/marker range matches the scale range EXACTLY. If scale marks go from startAngle to markEndAngle, use markEndAngle - startAngle (not endAngle - startAngle) for the indicator's angular range. Create a dbToNorm() mapping function for non-linear VU scales.
auto_learned_patterns.last_fix_description: VU meter needle range changed from fullArc (270°) to markRange (198°) to match the scale marks

common_cases: Arc from 135° to 405° (270° range), but scale marks only from 135° to 333° (198°)
Needle at 0dB points past the +5dB mark because the angular scale factors are different
Indicator position computed with normalizedLevel * fullArc instead of normalizedLevel * markRange
